>> Beyond mvn install: Maven Practices That Pay Off [foojay.io]

A tour of the cheap wins hiding in a pom.xml, drawn from real open-source projects: fail fast with the Enforcer, pin every plugin version through curated parent POMs, let profiles switch themselves on, and get an SBOM almost for free. Good stuff.

A very current problem – AI agents can write both the production code and the tests, what still protects us from functional errors? An interesting weekend read.
